one_line: AI regulation expands, Anthropic gears up for IPO, OpenAI boosts business services, and several new models launch.

themes.title: Global AI safety regulation grows
themes.text: Australia announced an AI safety regulator with mandatory breach reporting after an OpenAI agent incident. New York opened a registration portal for large AI developers under the RAISE Act, requiring safety frameworks and incident reporting.

stories.headline: Australia to create AI safety regulator and mandate breach reporting
New York launches portal for AI safety law requiring developer registration

themes.title: Anthropic IPO and investment activity
themes.text: Anthropic set IPO price range $70–$78 per share, targeting up to $1.4 trillion valuation, and announced share sales by co‑founders. Nvidia and TSMC committed up to $10 B and $1 B respectively to support the IPO. The company also scheduled a live‑stream event with CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon.

Anthropic sets IPO price range aiming for up to $1.4 trillion valuation
Anthropic targets $1.3tn valuation in IPO pricing 825 million shares at $70-$78
Nvidia plans $10B investment in Anthropic alongside its IPO

themes.title: OpenAI expands business services
themes.text: OpenAI launched a Business Hub beta allowing companies to create verified profiles and launch custom Business Agents in ChatGPT. Q3 revenue rose to $10 B, largely from enterprise API demand.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Business Hub and verified Business Agents in ChatGPT beta
OpenAI reports $10 billion in Q3 revenue as enterprise demand grows

themes.title: New AI models and tools released
themes.text: Meituan released LongCat‑2.5, a 1.6T‑parameter MoE model for long‑horizon tasks. Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon with a swarm feature. Anthropic introduced Claude Whiteboards, Sheets, and Data for collaborative work. DeepMind unveiled AlphaProof Code for deep software verification. Google announced TPU 8tx and 8i Max for confidential and large‑scale workloads.
